scaled_2d_obstacle_recovery.description: Scaled nonlinear 2D obstacle recovery benchmark mirroring the paper's unicycle complex-constraint recovery protocol.
scaled_2d_obstacle_recovery.notes: Paper values are the reported unicycle g3 recovery accuracies from Sec. 4.2. The gym uses a CPU-feasible scaled 2D boundary-band analogue with the same safe/unsafe recovery objective and equal demonstration-budget constraint.

accuracy.description: Fraction of uniformly sampled configuration states classified correctly.

balanced_accuracy.description: Mean safe and unsafe recall in a shuffled boundary band.

near_boundary_balanced_accuracy.description: Mean safe and unsafe recall within 0.035 coordinate units of the boundary.

safe_recall.description: Fraction of safe boundary-band states identified as safe.

unsafe_recall.description: Fraction of unsafe boundary-band states identified as unsafe.

n_demos.description: Number of requested demonstrations, penalizing methods that improve classification only by using a larger query budget.

_scale_note: Double-integrator dynamics are eliminated exactly and reconstructed at dt=1, T=30 in physical position units, bounds [-10,10]. Thirty-six paired private instances per experiment; 20-demonstration cap including one initial trajectory, 80 proposal cap, 3 GP fits, 1000 RFF. P3 starts near inferred boundary contacts; eta=1 in physical units and up to 24 four-sample acquisition rounds per stage. GP marginal likelihood uses analytic hypergradients. Boundary metrics and a complex-boundary stress experiment extend the paper sampling protocol. Original reported numbers remain in _paper_reported_*; split-specific benchmark measurements are separate. Existing measured values are interim fourth-job measurements until the common-initialization rerun replaces them.

double_integrator_g3.description: Private rotated/rescaled instances of the paper Appendix B g3 constraint, with double-integrator demonstrations.
double_integrator_g3.notes: Results are populated from end-to-end reference runs, not paper agreement targets. Baselines and anchors are recomputed from evaluator-owned raw records.
